profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is recorded as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, trading under the ticker RR with CIK 0001963685. Its listed website is rolls-royce.com, and the material drawn from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than a robotics business. In that material, Rolls-Royce describes itself as a developer of complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, and as having been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years.

The same material covers a $1 Billion investment completed in Indiana, described as cementing Indianapolis as an engine manufacturing and test campus; a stated strategic intent with Reliance Industries to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme; cooperation with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies; and multiple contractual commitments by Rolls-Royce SMR to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

No AI products are listed for the company, and no lawsuits, MCP servers or other cases are recorded. Its recorded law exposure is in Nevada, with a count of zero.
